name: Unicorn Wild Ox R V
overview: The biblical references to the unicorn, or wild ox, portray a creature of great strength and intractable nature, symbolizing formidable power under God's sovereign judgment. In Numbers 24:8 and Deuteronomy 33:17, the unicorn's strength and horns represent divine might used to subdue nations and gather God's people. Job 39:9-11 highlights the wild ox's untamable spirit and great strength, emphasizing that it cannot be domesticated or controlled by man. Psalm 22:21 uses the horns of the unicorn figuratively to express deliverance from danger, underscoring God's protective power.
